_what: The twenty class-to-class walks the door choice is scored on.
_why: Every pair is a walk a real UT student has on a real timetable, and BOTH ends are buildings UT Facilities itself surveyed in its Celebrated_Entrances layer (the doors maps.utexas.edu draws). Both ends scoreable is the whole point: a pair with an unsurveyed end can only be argued about, not measured. Weighted toward the buildings docs/walk-evidence.md measured as worst (EER, JES, BME, NHB, GDC, MEZ, WAG, MAI) so the list stresses the failure rather than avoiding it.
_metric: extra metres = distance from the door the router picked to the NEAREST door UT publishes for that building, summed over both ends of the pair. Zero means the walk ends where maps.utexas.edu says the entrance is.
_rerun: python scripts/serve.py 8711   then   VERIFY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8711 node scripts/verify/walkmeter.mjs
_source: UT Austin Celebrated_Entrances_view, services9.arcgis.com/w9x0fkENXvuWZY26, public and unauthenticated, fetched 2026-08-23. (c) The University of Texas at Austin.
